key.name: enabled
key.description: When off, no workspace is tiled and windows stay where they are.

key.name: gap
key.summary: Gap between columns and between stacked windows, in logical pixels

key.name: width-presets
key.summary: Column widths that cycle-width steps through, as fractions of the work area
key.description: 2 to 6 entries, each from 0.1 to 1.0, strictly increasing. Any other value is ignored and the defaults are used.

key.name: default-width
key.summary: Width of a new column, as a fraction of the work area; snaps to the nearest preset

key.name: animate
key.summary: Animate layout changes (also needs org.gnome.desktop.interface enable-animations)

key.name: focus-ring
key.summary: Draw a ring in the accent colour around the focused tiled window

key.name: app-rules
key.summary: Per-app rules: app id, float, initial width, own column
key.description: The app id matches, ignoring case, a window's GTK application id, sandboxed app id or WM_CLASS; the first matching rule wins. An initial width of 0 means the default width, 1 full width, anything else a fraction that snaps to the nearest preset.
